android.desc:
🚗 Trip Calculator – Fuel Cost & Route Tracker

Plan smarter, drive cheaper! 💰
Trip Calculator helps you estimate fuel costs, share trip expenses, and manage your saved routes perfect for road trips, commutes, and carpooling with friends.

🔹 Main Features

🧮 Quick Trip Calculator
Enter your distance, fuel price, and efficiency to instantly see your total cost, fuel usage, and cost per passenger.

💰 Cost Summary
View a clear breakdown of your trip expenses, including total cost, shared cost, and distance covered.

📍 Save & Label Routes
Keep your routes organized with custom names and labels like “Vacation,” “Work Trip,” or “Weekend Getaway.”

🌍 Flexible Units
Switch easily between kilometers/miles and liters/gallons ideal for travelers around the world.

📚 Saved Trips Overview
Browse all your saved routes in one place.
Filter or sort by cost, distance, or labels to find the perfect trip.

🔍 Detailed Trip Insights
See every detail price per liter, fuel efficiency, passenger count, and more for each saved route.

🚘 Perfect For

🚗 Road trippers & travel lovers

👥 Carpoolers splitting fuel costs

🚕 Delivery & rideshare drivers

🚙 Commuters tracking daily travel expenses

🌟 Why Choose Trip Calculator

✅ Fast and accurate calculations
✅ Save money by tracking real fuel usage
✅ Share costs fairly with passengers
✅ Clean, simple, and modern design
✅ Keep all your routes organized in one place

💬 Make Every Drive Smarter

Before your next trip, know exactly how much you’ll spend and save time, money, and fuel with Trip Calculator!

Download now and start planning your next adventure! 🚀
